requirements.text: Propose anonymous access to a reservation through a sharing link.
requirements.quote: Let anyone with a reservation sharing link view that reservation without signing in.
requirements.speaker: Owen
requirements.note: The baseline requires sign-in and explicitly excludes public reservation links. The policy is not approved. A named-collector alternative was discussed but not agreed.

requirements.text: Allow coordinators to invite prospective members by email.
requirements.quote: Coordinators must still be able to invite prospective members by email.
requirements.speaker: Owen

requirements.text: Allow coordinators to revoke unexpired invitations.
requirements.quote: Allow a coordinator to revoke an invitation before it expires.
requirements.speaker: Owen
requirements.note: Manual revocation is not in the baseline. Acceptance of a revoked invitation must fail without account creation. Invitation reminders were excluded.

requirements.quote: External collaborators should get the right access.
requirements.speaker: Nora
requirements.note: No collaborator role or permission matrix is defined.

expected_stories.title: Revoke a pending invitation
expected_stories.so_that: an invitation sent by mistake cannot create an account
acceptance_criteria: Given an unused unexpired invitation, when a coordinator revokes it, then it is marked revoked.
Given a revoked invitation, when someone attempts acceptance, then account creation is rejected with a revoked-invitation explanation.

questions: Should anonymous reservation links be permitted despite the private-access baseline?
Which pages and actions should external collaborators access, and through which account role?
